g.text: Vectoring dose response | all four scenes and both saved 15 km shapes
Accepted D on a common y-axis; no truncation or scene selection
All 115 D fits per shape pass R² ≥ 0.94; the first scene lacks enough dose levels for correlation, not for D. Negative-order responses remain visible.
Segmented: schematic stimulus without the smooth motion certificate. Smooth: screened control. Five orders are dependent, not independent scenes.
